name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
description: A tricep isolation exercise performed with a rope or straight bar attachment at a high cable pulley, extending the arms overhead. The overhead position places the long head of the triceps in a lengthened position, maximizing the stretch and providing greater hypertrophic stimulus compared to pushdown variations.

execution.starting_position: Stand facing away from a high cable pulley holding a rope attachment behind your head, elbows bent and pointing forward.
execution.setup_instructions: Attach a rope to the high cable pulley. Face away from the machine. Grab the rope and position it behind your head.
steps: Step 1: Keep the upper arms stationary and close to the head throughout.
Step 2: Extend the arms forward and downward, straightening the elbows.
Step 3: Fully extend the elbows at the bottom of the movement.
Step 4: Bend the elbows to return the hands behind the head under control.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the extension. Inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Allowing the upper arms to drop or flare during the movement
Using momentum by leaning the torso
safety_considerations: Keep the upper arms close to the head and stationary throughout
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension of the elbows at the front. Full elbow flexion at the back — elbows well above the head.
coaching_cues: Full stretch in the long head
